item.title: Taking on Neo-Nazis, One Trademark at a Time | 对抗新纳粹，一次一个商标
item.description:
In Germany, a campaign called Rights Against the Right is securing trademarks for right-wing symbols and phrases, aiming to cut into a revenue stream that sustains hate groups.

艾米·格里芬（ Amy Griffin ）辩称，当一名前同学在一起诉讼中指控她挪用她为“The Tell”遭受性虐待的故事的部分内容时，她受到了诽谤。

item.title: Working Parents Say They’re in a Losing Battle Over Their Time | 工作的父母说他们正在为自己的时间而输掉一场战斗
item.description:
Most like having a job but say it leaves them too few hours for their children and other pursuits, a Pew survey shows.
皮尤的一项调查显示，大多数人喜欢有工作，但他们说这给他们的孩子和其他追求留下的时间太少了。
